children: The Canadian dollar weakened against the greenback on Wednesday, and the yield on benchmark government debt held steady.
was trading 0.2% lower at C$1.3915 to the greenback, or 71.86 U.S. cents, after trading in a range of 1.3895 to 1.3939.
Canadian government 10-year bond yields (CA10YT=RR) rose 0 basis points to 3.748%. The yield on similar U.S. government benchmark debt fell to 4.7941%.
futures fell 38 cents to $89.84 a barrel on Wednesday.
